tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia (low hemoglobin, MCHC), and thrombocytopenia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or chronic disease. There is hyperlipidemia (high cholesterol, LDL, triglycerides), poor glycemic control (elevated HbA1c), mild hyperkalemia, and low total protein. Liver enzymes are low but not clinically significant. Renal function is normal. Recommend clinical correlation for possible hematologic disorder, metabolic syndrome, and diabetes management.
